title: "Friedman Was a Hedgehog"
date: "2011-07-16"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets"]
---

[John Cochrane](http://www.cato-unbound.org/2011/07/15/john-h-cochrane/in-defense-of-the-hedgehogs/): ‘economic events should be unforecastable, and their unforecastability is a sign that the markets and our theories about them are working well.’
